title: STAT <msgid> in group.rs returns 430 stub regardless of msgid_map
description:
## What / Why
In crates/reader/src/session/commands/group.rs, stat_article() for the message-id form always returns Response::no_article_with_message_id() (430) regardless of whether the article exists. The comment says 'msgid form: return 430 stub'. RFC 3977 §6.2.4 requires STAT <msgid> to return 223 if the article exists or 430 if it does not.

## Risk
Newsreaders that use STAT <msgid> to check article existence before fetching (e.g. to skip known articles) will get 430 for every article, causing them to re-fetch every article they already have or skip fetching entirely. This breaks standard client behavior.

## Fix
Wire stat_article's msgid branch to msgid_map.lookup_by_msgid(). This requires the store to be passed into stat_article, or the lookup must be done in lifecycle.rs before calling stat_article.
